verdict.rationale: Whether a cloud platform that hosts customer code and data uses that data for AI training is a fair question, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out, no data-use policy, and no stated no-training commitment. The only related item is an opt-out for Render CLI usage telemetry, which is an adjacent control and does not address AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
